data.long_meaning: Devayani is a Sanskrit name derived from the words ‘Deva’ meaning god and ‘Yani’ meaning mother or youthful. In Hindu mythology, Devayani is the name of a celestial woman and the mother of the god Indra. She is also known as the goddess of the gods and is revered for her beauty, grace, and strength. The name Devayani carries the meaning “Goddess of Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Devayani usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
